note: The single-Queued contract (framework/core/build-pipeline.mjs, last section): at most one build in status queued, promote() moves the oldest Pending build up when the queued one goes live, and hold / cancel / unqueue are stops only an owner actor reverses. Every port replays each case: run `op` on `in` at `now` and answer `out`. Ops: queue, promote, goLive, hold, cancel, unqueue, release, settleQueue answer { ok, why, statuses (id → status), stops (id → standing stop kind), queued [ids], promoted?, changes, kill?, invariant (checkQueue(builds).ok) }; keepStop answers { kept, why, status, stop, build }; checkQueue, pendingOrder ({ order, waits }), isOwnerActor (actor → bool) and orchestrator ({ shown, sent }) answer their value; sequence runs `ops` in order on one evolving list and answers the view after each (`write` = an automated writer stores { ...record, ...patch } through keepStop; its view adds `kept`).
